dedupe_keys.name: three epanet network models representing intermittent water supply systems

description: This dataset holds three water distribution network models adapted to represent intermittent water supply. Each is an EPANET 2.2 input file that cites the original network and the adaptation method; the files support a 2024 Journal of Water Resources Planning and Management paper on equality of supply in unrestricted intermittent networks. John Gibson and David Meyer of the University of Toronto published them on Borealis in October 2024 as a free download under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is three generic benchmark networks, not real cities. Caveats: the networks are adaptations of existing benchmarks, not measured intermittent systems. Simulation uses: testing intermittent supply schedules, equity of delivery and network flow optimisation. Related records: the Exeter Centre for Water Systems benchmark networks (data-exeter-cws-water-network-benchmarks) and EPANET (model-epanet).
